acceptance: A guard test fails on a Setrlimit call in a test body that is not a child-process helper
No test in the tree lowers a process-wide rlimit
fix: Add a tree guard test that refuses syscall.Setrlimit in _test.go files except inside a named child-process helper, so the class cannot return.
summary: 2026-11-24: the rank-38 commit gate failed with 'testing: can't write testlog.txt: file too large' although every test passed. Root cause: opscmd/fsize_unix_backfill_f2_test.go (#866) sets RLIMIT_FSIZE=0 for the whole test process, so any write in that window fails with EFBIG, including the go test testlog flush; new file opens elsewhere moved a flush into the window. commentaudit/fsfull_backfill_f2_test.go has the same pattern. The two tests are being fixed in the rank-38 PR (child-process helper).
title: A test never lowers a process-wide rlimit; a guard refuses Setrlimit in tests outside a child-process helper
